title: Local transcription engine: whisper.cpp base.en on the laptop, 5-second slices with a queue, model download on first use, model update setting
story: Grillo can now turn speech into text on the laptop with whisper.cpp base.en. On first use it downloads the model, checks it and keeps it in the app data folder; a speechModelUpdates setting decides what happens when a newer model is published. Nothing a user sees has changed yet.
no_qa_reason: Main-process code and IPC channels only, no screen; a person can drive it once the meeting panel and the setup check screen are built.
